scope: Implementation prototype; independent reviewer required; no board or deployment qualification

cold.payload: N block-major ordinary signed32 digits; 16 signed c0; 16 signed c1
cold.data_record: 32-byte LE record with explicit session32/lease32/context/full56 owner/index/raw32
cold.retained_setup: R96/A77 wire fields reserved zero; original START/PROFILE computes and validates them
cold.commit: Complete destination ACKs and exact header/lease/idle authority; raw image readiness only
cold.partial_or_reset: Revoke publication and drain both domains; payload is not rolled back; full reload required
cold.physical_ports: Integrator-supplied lease/grant; peer address independence alone is not a physical port grant

descriptors: Idle external backpressure is legal; active frame-launch underflow is typed abort, never internal calendar stall

exports.A: canonical96-natural-image-v1: retained already-materialized N signed96 canonical words, full56 owner/context/completed sequence; exact special image [-1,0,...]. Use directly; NEVER invoke raw carry finalizer
exports.A_software_codec: Twelve-byte LE payload sits inside owned session/full56/index framing; vendor DMA packet is not assigned. Coherent final error/publication fence and all N ordered full-width words are required
exports.B: raw32-natural-carry-c0-c1-v1: requested NEW pre-canonical endpoint with N raw signed32 carry digits, 2P c0/c1, owner/row/count. Source/tap/storage/overflow/native equivalence not qualified; adapter refuses it
exports.format_policy: Unknown or mixed formats reject; no canonical96-to-raw32 trimming or second finalization

checkpoint.implemented: Private R15CP1 source/owner/context/profile/count/residue digest and restore model
checkpoint.persistent_atomic_store: Two independent default-OFF private mode0600 POSIX files, fsync/replace/directory-fsync and identity/bounds/digest validation. Stable host-run identity is not the per-job owner. Restart requires actual common reset/drain/full reload; software interruption tests are not real power-loss qualification

gerbicz_li.implemented: GMP/software modular product-window identity; corrupt window restores last verified residue; original genefer PRP product schedule
gerbicz_li.hardware_binding: Pending source-own DIRECT65/70 end-A chunk integration. No arbitrary in-job checkpoints; bounded feed windows keep GLOBAL PRP ordinal separate from per-job full56 owner. Profile/cold/canonical/transport/host-check gaps excluded from existing compute projection

proof.implemented: Non-CYCLO little-endian version1/depth/gint records/hash/challenge/CRC; PL relation prototype
proof.oracle: Exact upstream PL/GL methods with synthetic N32 GMP transform fixture prepared, execution pending

vfio: Inert userspace capability/MMIO abstraction; real device bind/open/ioctl/DMA/IRQ and vendor BAR mapping unimplemented
reset_delivery: Only common board reset/link-reset semantics are specified by hardware author. VFIO/FLR/MMIO soft-reset delivery is unbound; software/mock reset ACK is not hardware recovery proof
boinc: Anonymous-platform XML and injected status/checkpoint/slot scaffold only; SDK linkage, app IDs, input/upload integration unimplemented
performance: Report measured backend, host conversion/check/proof and transport time separately; no brief timing/size estimate inherited
